subject: Next steps: align on dedicated throughput slot + demo window
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Green <sophie.green@cumulus.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: align on dedicated throughput slot + demo window

Sophie — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock a technical deep-dive and sizing session for dedicated capacity: 

Recap (from today's discovery)
- Primary workload: customer support routing + short-form summarization for chat (mix of single-turn and short multi-turn).
- Target SLA: 95th pctl generation latency <= 250ms for 512-token responses under p95 concurrency.
- Expected steady-state QPS: ~18 req/s; peak burst up to 85 req/s for 60-90s.
- Model family: leaning toward an Llama2-variant (quantized) or an equivalent open model; could test multiple candidates in the sizing call.

Proposed next steps
1) Technical deep-dive + dedicated capacity sizing call (45–60m) — agenda: workload profile, sequence length distribution, request tracing/headers, perf goals, and recommended pool size & quantization options.
2) Follow-up demo (30m) showing inference behavior with your sample traces and how batching/caching affects cost and latency.

Availability — my suggestion:
- Wed Jun 9: 09:00–10:30 PT or 13:00–15:00 PT
- Thu Jun 10: 11:00–13:00 PT

Prep items (we'll send a short checklist):
- Example request traces (1k lines preferred) and tokens-per-request distribution
- Expected concurrency windows (time of day) and any SLAs tied to specific routes

I've attached a short throughput-sizing checklist and a template you can drop sample numbers into before the call. Lauren and Marcus from Solutions will join — Lauren on the intake and Marcus on runtime/quantization tradeoffs.

If those slots don't work, suggest 2 alternatives and we'll follow up with a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: throughput-sizing-checklist.pdf, pool-requirements-template.xlsx

Thanks, Aditya — really useful recap. Wed Jun 9 at 09:00 PT works for our engineers (Sam and Priya) and me. We'll aim to have a short anonymized trace file in advance. Couple quick clarifications so your team can prep: 

- The 95th pctl target is for user-visible generation time (end-to-end), so we care about total server-side tokens + network overhead; we will share our internal measurement method.
- Our peak bursts are usually during business hour syncs (around 11:30 PT) but we also see a second smaller spike at 03:00 UTC.

I'll accept a calendar invite for Wed 9 at 09:00 PT. Can you include a brief list of sample model variants you'll test and whether you recommend quantized fp16 vs int8?

Best,
Sophie Green
Head of Product Engineering | Cumulus AI
sophie.green@cumulus.ai
